promptLines: - A language server is available for this project. To find where a symbol is defined, every place it is used, or its type, prefer lsp_definition, lsp_references, and lsp_hover over text search: they follow imports and skip same-named text. Rename a symbol with lsp_rename rather than editing each use by hand.

tools.name: lsp_definition
tools.description: Find where a symbol is defined, using the project's language server (type-aware: follows imports, re-exports, and overloads that text search can't). Give the file, the 1-based line, and the symbol as written there.

path.description: File containing the symbol, relative to the project root.

line.description: 1-based line number of the symbol, as read_file shows it.

symbol.description: The symbol as written on that line, e.g. "parseConfig".

occurrence.description: Which occurrence of symbol on that line, when it appears more than once (default 1).

tools.name: lsp_references
tools.description: List every reference to a symbol across the project, using the language server (only real uses of this symbol, not same-named text). Give the file, the 1-based line, and the symbol as written there.

path.description: File containing the symbol, relative to the project root.

line.description: 1-based line number of the symbol, as read_file shows it.

symbol.description: The symbol as written on that line, e.g. "parseConfig".

occurrence.description: Which occurrence of symbol on that line, when it appears more than once (default 1).

include_declaration.description: Also list the declaration itself (default true).

tools.name: lsp_hover
tools.description: Show a symbol's type, signature, and documentation from the language server, as an editor's hover would. Give the file, the 1-based line, and the symbol as written there.

path.description: File containing the symbol, relative to the project root.

line.description: 1-based line number of the symbol, as read_file shows it.

symbol.description: The symbol as written on that line, e.g. "parseConfig".

occurrence.description: Which occurrence of symbol on that line, when it appears more than once (default 1).

tools.name: lsp_document_symbols
tools.description: Outline a file: its classes, functions, methods, and other symbols with their line numbers, from the language server.

path.description: File containing the symbol, relative to the project root.

tools.name: lsp_workspace_symbols
tools.description: Find symbols (classes, functions, types, ...) by name across the project, from the language server. Give a file in the part of the project to search: the server searches the project that file belongs to.

query.description: The name or part of it, e.g. "parseConfig".

path.description: Any file in the language to search, relative to the project root.

tools.name: lsp_rename
tools.description: Rename a symbol everywhere it is used, using the language server (a semantic rename: only this symbol, across files, including imports). Give the file, the 1-based line, and the symbol as written there, plus the new name. The edits are applied as one apply_patch, with the same approval and checkpoint (undo) as any patch.

path.description: File containing the symbol, relative to the project root.

line.description: 1-based line number of the symbol, as read_file shows it.

symbol.description: The symbol as written on that line, e.g. "parseConfig".

occurrence.description: Which occurrence of symbol on that line, when it appears more than once (default 1).
